description.fun: Stantler's eye-like antlers bend the air around them to create illusions, and staring into them can leave you too dizzy to stand. Those antlers were so prized as works of art that Stantler was nearly hunted to extinction. Its Japanese name nods to the shishi-odoshi, a device for scaring deer away, and the games' English translator once suggested calling it 'Scaribou'.
description.guide: A Normal-type deer Pokémon whose eye-like antlers can create illusions and make onlookers dizzy. It was nearly hunted to extinction for its antlers. In Legends: Arceus it evolves into Wyrdeer after using Psyshield Bash in the agile style 20 times.
description.tagline: A deer whose eye-like antlers spin dizzying illusions

description.fun: Wyrdeer was beloved in old Hisui for its warm fur, which people made into clothing, and it used the black orbs on its antlers to bend space, raise invisible barriers and lead Stantler herds along safe paths. Its white beard and eyebrows give it the air of a wise old wizard. It seems to be extinct now, and today's Stantler no longer evolve into it.
description.guide: A Normal- and Psychic-type deer Pokémon from Legends: Arceus, the evolution of Stantler. Its antlers channel psychic power that can distort space and create barriers, and its fur was prized for warm clothing. It is implied to be extinct in the present day.
description.tagline: Hisui's bearded deer, a psychic guide with antenna antlers

transitions.how: Use Psyshield Bash in the Agile Style 20 times

note.text: Stantler evolves into Wyrdeer after using Psyshield Bash in the agile style 20 times, a method from Legends: Arceus. Scarlet and Violet have the evolution in their code but no way to trigger it.
